TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna ni-millingigh ta ti Herodes ka sat ki vouel ki pahpat ki Meisasou ki pourough ki kakalauakau ti Jesus.
S.TRANSL: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
那時，分封的王希律聽見耶穌的名聲，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ki rarauwei tyn, Ti Joannes ka na Tama-æulough ta ti atta, Ni-pa-æhpyt-en ta teni ki ni-kapat-ei-an, ka alei ki atta peiraring-ei-en tyni-æn ta ka ilhgen ka ringei.
S.TRANSL: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
就對臣僕說：「這是施洗的約翰從死裏復活，所以這些異能從他裏面發出來。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-pa-tau ta ti Herodes ti Joannes-an, ni-pavæuut pa-pousang-at tyni-æn alei ti Herodias-an ka kei-'en ki tæ'i-appara tyn ka ti Filippus.
S.TRANSL: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
起先，希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，把約翰拿住，鎖在監裏。

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta ti Joannes tyni-æn, Assi kow hahei-en mei'a tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
因為約翰曾對他說：「你娶這婦人是不合理的。」

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-kamoei-in tyn paka-patei tyni-æn ni-mahtakout ki ta'u, alei ka Tama-mattæi-tan ta teni ni-k'ma ta rÿh nein.
S.TRANSL: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
希律就想要殺他，只是怕百姓，因為他們以約翰為先知。

S.FORM: Ka tou wæ'i ki ou-vavatoug-an ki ni-pei-alak ta ti Herodes, ni-rmang-toungtoul ta tatimi-in ti Herodias tou toukad [neini-æn] ka ni-ky-heil-an ti Horodes.
S.TRANSL: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
到了希律的生日，希羅底的女兒在眾人面前跳舞，使希律歡喜。

S.FORM: Ka ni-patou-msing saulkut tyni-æn pi'æ̈ ki mamang ki toumimi-'auh tyn.
S.TRANSL: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
希律就起誓，應許隨她所求的給她。

S.FORM: Teni-râ dou ni-pako-ouro-en matæutæuuh ti Jna tyn, p'ææ̈nei jau-an, koun tyn, tou tangia ta voung-o ti Joannes ka Tama-æulough.
S.TRANSL: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
女兒被母親所使，就說：「請把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏，拿來給我。」

S.FORM: Ka kæuh-boulas ta Si-bavau ka Mei-sasou, râ alei ki ni-saoul-kit-tan, alei-appa neini-æn ka mi-sâl [tyni-æn] mavok, ni-pakou-sou-en tyn ka p'hæ-aneih.
S.TRANSL: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
王便憂愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐給她；

S.FORM: Ka ni-madingi pa-tibbou ki voungo ti Joannes tou sangat.
S.TRANSL: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
於是打發人去，在監裏斬了約翰，

S.FORM: Ka ni-ad ta voungo tyn tou tangia, ka ni-p'hæn ta tatimi-in, ka ni-mad pou-qua ti Jna-tyn-en.
S.TRANSL: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給了女子；女子拿去給她母親。

S.FORM: Ka ni-iroua ta Pæhtatæutæu-'en tyn, ka ni-ara nein ta vouel tyn, ka ni-ravak nein ta anna: ka ni-mouqua banna-vanna ti Jesus-an.
S.TRANSL: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
約翰的門徒來，把屍首領去埋葬了，就去告訴耶穌。

S.FORM: Ka rou illing-hen ti Jesus [ta anna] ni-tau-avang d'marang hynna mou-snæh tou poulæh tou itou-'nni-en: jrou ka illing-hen ki makoi-lalaulau [ta atta] ni-tau-pourough ta neni tou æuma-æuma smala-dyllough tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
耶穌聽見了，就上船從那裏獨自退到野地裏去。眾人聽見，就從各城裏步行跟隨他。

S.FORM: Irou ka 'tpæpænæh ta ti Jesus ni-k'ytt'an tyn ta makoi-lalaulau ka mabatoung, ka ni-mararÿh maharim neini-æn, ka ni-padarykkag-en tyn ta maälam nein.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，治好了他們的病人。

S.FORM: Irou ka madoung-ato, ni-iroua ta Pahtatæutæu-en tyn tyni-æn, koun, Mapæulapæulah ta itou-quan, ka mali-kaha'to mali-daæua ta kidi: pa-darang-auto ymhou-an ta makoi-lalaulau, alei ka mouqu'ah tou æuma-æuma peila ki kan-nauh nein.
S.TRANSL: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
天將晚的時候，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，時候已經過了，請叫眾人散開，他們好往村子裏去，自己買吃的。」

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Assi pæi-ææ̈po-en ka d'marang-ah ta neni: p'hei-'to ki kan'nauh nein ta emoumi.
S.TRANSL: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
耶穌說：「不用他們去，你們給他們吃吧！」

S.FORM: Neni-râ ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Aousi-kame hia ki mamang, dyk ryrymma ki paoul, dourouha-appa ki thing.
S.TRANSL: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
門徒說：「我們這裏只有五個餅，兩條魚。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta teni, Ad-dikoh ki anna pouqua hia.
S.TRANSL: He said, Bring them hither to me.
耶穌說：「拿過來給我。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-paieroung-en tyn ta makoi-lalaulau tou kouvoul, ka rou ni-ara tyn ta ryrymma ki paoul dourouha-appa ki thung, tou ni-pasaou-vavullum-en nipaka-riang, ki sou: ka rou ni-pihpi tyn, ni-p'-æn tyn ta paoul ki Pahtatæutæu-en, ka Pahtatæutæu-en tyn [ta ni-pæ'ä-tounnoun] ki makoi-lalaulau.
S.TRANSL: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
於是吩咐眾人坐在草地上，就拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒又遞給眾人。

S.FORM: Ka ni-k-ymmid kman ka mi-bangtau ta neni, ka ni-ara nein ki na pyhpi ka ni-k-da kman, sat kytti-æn,'æb' ki rouha ka la'i-æn ta matt'moej.
S.TRANSL: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
他們都吃，並且吃飽了，把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。

S.FORM: Neni ka ni-kman, na rymma ka tounoun-nan lava ta papæræh, dou assi eikoun ta jnæjna ki alalak-appa.
S.TRANSL: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
吃的人，除了婦女孩子，約有五千。

S.FORM: Ka madys ni-mihgarei ta ti Jesus pa-ou-avang ki Pahtatæutæuuh-en tyn pasiouro neini-æn pouarough, dou pa-darang-auh tyn ta makoi-lalaulau.
S.TRANSL: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊去，等他叫眾人散開。

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-pa-darang-en tyn ta makoi-lalaulau, ni-mæddak-kun mou-voukyn tou saät mako-alilid. Irou ka madoung-ato, ni-makoui-saät tou hynna.
S.TRANSL: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
散了眾人以後，他就獨自上山去禱告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那裏。

S.FORM: Ka æ'ia-toukad ki vaoung ta avang, ka ni-pa-rako-rakou ki roungwal: alei ka hma-douma ta vare.
S.TRANSL: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
那時船在海中，因風不順，被浪搖撼。

S.FORM: Râ tou kaahpat ki souääjam dou euv'nen, ni-tdarum mouqua neini-æn ta ti Jesus mou-naunang hmi-halap ki [raloum ka tou] vaoung.
S.TRANSL: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
夜裏四更天，耶穌在海面上走，往門徒那裏去。

S.FORM: Irou ka kmytta ta Pahtatæutæu'han tyn ka ounaunang-en tyn hmi-halap ki vaoung, ni-miharaf-haf ki rÿh, koun nein, Tubbul-lava k'anna: ka ni-hmouhouwahouwau alei ki takout ta neni.
S.TRANSL: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
門徒看見他在海面上走，就驚慌了，說：「是個鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起來。

S.FORM: Râ madys masousou neini-æn ta ti Jesus, ka koun tyn, Pæhshuttâ ki rÿh, ti jau k'atta, ynna mahtakout.
S.TRANSL: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心，是我，不要怕！」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Petrus k'ma tyni-æn, Meirang, heirou ymhou k'atta, doumiaka pa-ouqua-i-koh ymhou-an pa-ou-halap ki raloum.
S.TRANSL: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
彼得說：「主，如果是你，請叫我從水面上走到你那裏去。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta teni, Ou-qua-au: ka rou ni-mou-rarim ki avang ta ti Petrus, ni-mou-naunang hmi-halap ki raloum alei ki ou-qu'eih tyn ti Jesus-ang.
S.TRANSL: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
耶穌說：「你來吧。」彼得就從船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶穌那裏去；

S.FORM: Irou ka k'ytt'an tyn ta vare ka maligh-da, mahtakout-ato, ka rou mei-nounamou mou-rub, ni-hmouwahouwau, k'ma, Meirang, kadingou-koh.
S.TRANSL: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
只因見風甚大，就害怕，將要沉下去，便喊着說：「主啊，救我！」

S.FORM: Irou ka madys sikkiskih ta ti Jesus ki rima ni-hyhpyt tyni-æn, ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Ousyng-kow ki tna-msing-an, ka'umang ka ni-paka-rallah kow ki rÿh?
S.TRANSL: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，說：「你這小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑呢？」

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-maddakkun mou-avang ta neni, palungpung-ato ta vare.
S.TRANSL: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
他們上了船，風就住了。

S.FORM: Neni-râ ka æ'ia-avang ni-mou-qua tmamud tyni-æn, koun, Missing Alak kow ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
在船上的人都拜他，說：「你真是上帝的兒子了。」

S.FORM: Ka rou tau-avang mou-arough, ni-iroua tou pou-rough ka Gennesareth.
S.TRANSL: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
他們過了海，來到革尼撒勒地方。

S.FORM: Ka rou kalang-in ta teni ki pæpæræh ki itou-quan k'anna, ni-madingï tou ryttoung ki ymmid ki pourough ka tou tamang hynna, ka ni-ad nein paouqua tyni-æn ta ymmid ka maälam.
S.TRANSL: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
那裏的人一認出是耶穌，就打發人到周圍地方去，把所有的病人帶到他那裏，

S.FORM: Ka ni-tmou-mimia tyni-æn ka smou-dyk-ah smoukla ki na papytpyt ki koulamough tyn: ka timamang ta ni-smoukla, ni padarikag-en.
S.TRANSL: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
只求耶穌准他們摸他的衣裳繸子；摸着的人就都好了。
